targets.authors: Pope P. A.; Miall R. C.
targets.title: Task-specific facilitation of cognition by cathodal transcranial direct current stimulation of the cerebellum
targets.evidence_quote: The primary aim of the present study was to replicate the facilitatory effect immediately after cathodal c-tDCS on language task performance, as reported by Pope and Miall (i.e., their experiment 2) [ 20 ].
targets.outcome_quote: Our results did not show a facilitating effect of cathodal c-tDCS on verb generation, in terms of either verbal response times or variability.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The targeted cathodal stimulation facilitation was absent; task and priming checks are incidental to that central finding.

reasoning: New Dutch sample retests the published verb-generation stimulation finding.
